sections.title: Financial Analysis
sections.summary: Financial performance remains constructive with explicit omission handling.
narrative_paragraphs: Revenue, margin, and free-cash-flow trends are discussed together so the report does not over-index on a single headline metric.
Where annual history is complete enough, the report turns those trends into a more durable financial read rather than a quarter-only reaction.

sections.title: Competitive Positioning
sections.summary: Competitive read stays grounded in approved evidence only.
narrative_paragraphs: The report uses segment mix and approved context to discuss where the business still looks durable.
It does not claim unsupported market-share precision when the source set is thinner than that.
omissions: Exact market-share evidence is not part of this fixture.

sections.title: Management and Governance
sections.summary: Management commentary is usable, governance remains intentionally constrained.
narrative_paragraphs: Management tone is interpreted through approved transcript and filing evidence rather than impressionistic commentary.
Governance detail is limited unless proxy-grade materials are explicitly available in the run.
omissions: Proxy-grade governance detail unavailable in this fixture.

sections.title: Risks and Challenges
sections.summary: Risks remain falsifiable through explicit break conditions.
narrative_paragraphs: The risk section uses explicit kill switches and omission notes rather than generic warnings.
That keeps the report accountable to conditions that could actually change the stance.

sections.title: Growth Opportunities and Outlook
sections.summary: Outlook is discussed conservatively and only where approved evidence supports it.
narrative_paragraphs: Growth opportunities are framed around visible business drivers and management commentary.
The report avoids stretching the source plane into unsupported long-range forecasts.

sections.title: Valuation and Thesis Stance
sections.summary: Valuation stays deterministic and tied to stance language rather than buy or sell labels.
narrative_paragraphs: The valuation section keeps fair-value framing inside a deterministic scenario framework.
It also explains what would change the current stance instead of treating price targets as the thesis itself.
